title: Post a job
summary: Tell providers what you need, step by step.

steps.headline: Post a job
steps.body: On Home, tap Post a job to begin.
steps.narration: To start, tap Post a job on your Home screen.

steps.headline: Service
steps.body: Pick the kind of work you need, like plumbing or cleaning.
steps.narration: Step one is Service. Choose the kind of work you need, like plumbing or cleaning.

steps.headline: Where
steps.body: Add the address where the work will happen.
steps.narration: Step two is Where. Add the address where the work will happen.

steps.headline: Tasks
steps.body: Tick the tasks you need, or add your own, and describe the job.
steps.narration: Step three is Tasks. Tick the tasks you need, add your own, and describe the job.

steps.headline: When & price
steps.body: Pick a date and time, choose how urgent it is, then choose a price.
steps.narration: Step four is When and price. Pick a date and time, and say how urgent it is.

steps.headline: Choose a price
steps.body: Pick one of three estimated prices: basic, standard or premium.
steps.narration: Then choose one of three estimated prices: basic, standard or premium.

steps.headline: Review and post
steps.body: Check everything, then tap Post job.
steps.narration: Last, review everything and tap Post job. Nearby providers will see it right away.

steps.headline: Your job is live
steps.body: Tap View my jobs to follow it. Providers can now send proposals.
steps.narration: Your job is now live. Tap View my jobs to follow it, and wait for providers to send proposals.
